product.name: Harness
product.lede: Give a model a task, decide what it can touch, and keep a record of every turn. Harness talks to model APIs directly, asks before a tool call above the run's risk ceiling, and holds the run to the bounds you set.
product.meta: Rust · OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages · Linux · LicenseRef-B10x-Proprietary

sections.title: A capability is a boundary, not a promise in a prompt.
sections.lede: Begin with a read-only workspace. File changes and process execution appear only when a confinement boundary can provide them, and a missing capability is reported as withheld.

items.title: Read the workspace
items.description: file_read, dir_list, search and find, bounded to the workspace root. The default needs no substrate and publishes no write tool; b10x-harness tools prints the catalogue without contacting a model.

items.title: Admit a change
items.description: A confined workspace adds file_write and file_edit. Each call still meets the run's approval ceiling and its ordered write scope.

items.title: Allow execution
items.description: run starts an argv, never a shell string, and only for a program declared with --allow-program, inside confined execution. A host that cannot confine it withholds the tool.

items.title: Budgets that bind
items.description: Turn, token, duration and context-window ceilings, and a spend ceiling when a dated rate card prices the model. Unreported usage stays unknown and is never counted as zero.

items.title: A readable record
items.description: Sessions are written outside the workspace and resume locally; --json streams vendor-neutral JSON Lines events for another program.

items.title: Driven by a real external client
items.description: Bridge mode serves the loop over JSON-RPC on stdio and is contract-tested, but no real external client has driven it yet.

sections.title: The model proposes. The loop decides.
sections.lede: Every turn is assembled from the local conversation and sent as a complete request. A refusal comes back to the model as a failed tool outcome, so it learns the effect did not happen.
